excluded: D07.5 — Carcinoma in situ of prostate (pre-invasive)

cookbook_master_readme.invariants: Xu-538 Stage 1 panel, H_min(immune) = 0.838889, H_min(secretory) = 0.843264, Moss 2018 NNLS Stage 2, EpiDISH Stage 3

universal_pipeline_acknowledgment.note: The Stage 1 → Stage 2 → Stage 3 pipeline is invariant across all cards. See universal_reference block below for canonical specification.

panel.source: Xu Z, Sandler DP, Taylor JA. JNCI 2020 doi:10.1093/jnci/djz065

stage_1_immune_flag.note_for_prostate: Xu-538 is a breast-derived panel. On prostate tissue, VAL-058 (GSE269244 n=238) demonstrated that the panel separates prostate tumor from adjacent-normal tissue at d_paired = +0.497, establishing the panel transfers to prostate at tissue level. Per-patient pre-diagnostic blood performance of Xu-538 for prostate cancer is NOT validated by this card; Health ABC and Rotterdam cohorts required for that validation remain dbGaP-gated as of 2026-04-24.

stage_2_localization.moss_atlas_reference: Moss J et al. Nat Commun 2018 — 25 tissue cfDNA methylation atlas
stage_2_localization.clinical_firing_criterion: Stage 2 Moss NNLS returns prostate_epithelial as top-1 localization AND Xu-538 Stage 1 immune A-score is at or above DETECTABLE tier
stage_2_localization.note_for_prostate: This card fires when both (a) Stage 1 immune panel flags and (b) Stage 2 Moss NNLS localizes to prostate_epithelial. The card does NOT serve as a pre-diagnostic blood screening test; it serves the clinical scenario where an EDEAR analysis produces a Stage 1 flag + Stage 2 prostate localization.

DETECTABLE_tier.recommended_action: PSA test + digital rectal examination (DRE); if indicated, multi-parametric prostate MRI; urology consultation
DETECTABLE_tier.rationale: Consistent with current NCCN prostate cancer early detection guidelines

ELEVATED_tier.recommended_action: Accelerated urology referral; MRI-guided biopsy consideration per urologist judgment
ELEVATED_tier.rationale: Higher architectural drift signal consistent with more advanced pre-clinical or early-clinical disease

pre_existing_diagnosis.recommended_action: Card fires as monitoring data point; consult oncology team for interpretation alongside standard biomarkers (PSA kinetics, imaging)

card_does_NOT_provide: Aggressive vs indolent disease stratification (Gleason risk)

validation_tier_rationale: VAL-058 (GSE269244 n=238 EPIC 850K African-American men) demonstrated Xu-538 immune panel separates prostate tumor from adjacent-normal tissue at unpaired d = +0.400 [95% CI +0.146, +0.659] and paired d = +0.497 (118 complete tumor-normal pairs, p = 0.0001). This is tissue-level validation supporting Stage 2 Moss NNLS prostate_epithelial localization firing. The card does NOT have per-patient pre-diagnostic blood validation — that tier would require a cohort like Health ABC or Rotterdam Study (both dbGaP-gated).

primary_validation.cohort_description: Epigenome-wide DNA methylation in Prostate Cancer in African American Men
primary_validation.population: African American men (underserved, highest PCa incidence globally)
primary_validation.per_cpg_direction: On Xu-538 specifically: 45.1% hypermethylated in tumor (217/481); published Berglund 2024 reports genome-wide hypermethylation trend (which is not the same as panel-specific trend).

known_limitations: VAL-058 is tissue-level; per-patient pre-diagnostic blood detection for prostate cancer is NOT validated by this card. Future validation requires Health ABC or Rotterdam Study (dbGaP-gated as of 2026-04-24).

VAL-058 cohort is 100% African American men; European and Asian ancestry validation pending. Prostate cancer genomics and epigenomics differ by ancestry; direct transfer is an assumption, not a demonstrated fact.

The Xu-538 panel was derived from Sister Study breast cancer and replicated in EPIC-Italy breast cancer. Its application to prostate tissue works at d_paired = +0.497, but this is not the panel's original intent. A prostate-specific directional panel (analogous to VAL-051 7-CpG AD panel) may outperform Xu-538 for prostate-specific applications.

Gleason grade stratification (aggressive vs indolent) is NOT within scope of this card. The card fires on tumor vs normal; it does not distinguish GG1 from GG4/5. That stratification is a separate validation (aggressive-subgrade analysis was in VAL-058 raw output but not pre-registered for card firing).
FFPE tissue specimens may have methylation artifacts from formalin fixation. VAL-058 used published processed β values from the original study, which applied standard ChAMP/normal FFPE correction.

Sample size n=238 is below the n≥300 threshold for full cohort_screening_validated tier. Upgrading to cohort_screening_validated would require either (a) n increase via data sharing from additional prostate tissue cohorts, or (b) demonstration on an independent replication cohort.

CCFDNA SHEDDING LIMITATION FOR PROSTATE: Stage 2 Moss NNLS firing on prostate_epithelial requires sufficient prostate-derived ccfDNA in plasma. Metastatic and advanced prostate cancer sheds detectably (Moss 2018 Fig 4d: β 0.635 vs healthy 0.743). Early-stage localized prostate cancer sheds minimally compared to liver, lung, or CRC. A negative Stage 2 Moss deconvolution does NOT rule out early-stage localized prostate cancer. Moss deconvolution is a positive-finding test, not a rule-out test, for this disease.

URINE SPECIMEN PATHWAY NOT YET INTEGRATED: Published urine-methylation prostate tests (SelectMDx, ConfirmMDx, Widschwendter UroMark) demonstrate that urinary prostate cells shed continuously and can support early-stage detection that blood ccfDNA cannot. A urine-specimen Stage 1 pathway with prostate-specific H_min and panel would materially improve this card's early-disease sensitivity. Not validated in Cookbook v2.1 architecture; listed as a card upgrade requirement for prostate-epic v0.2+.

BLOOD IMMUNE-CLASS DATA STILL NEEDED: Unlike breast-epic, crc-epic, and lung-epic which have blood immune-panel cohort-level evidence from VAL-046 or equivalent, prostate-epic has NO per-patient pre-diagnostic blood immune-class validation. The card fires on Stage 2 Moss localization of prostate_epithelial, backed by VAL-058 tissue-level demonstration that Xu-538 separates prostate tumor from adjacent-normal. Stage 1 blood immune-class firing for prostate is NOT independently validated. Health ABC and Rotterdam Study remain dbGaP-gated.
next_validation_steps: Replication on European-ancestry prostate tissue (GSE76938, GSE116338, TCGA-PRAD for cross-sectional) to test ancestry generalizability.
Health ABC or Rotterdam Study blood methylation access via data-use application (2–12 week approval cycle).

Prostate-specific directional panel derivation analogous to VAL-051 AD panel: identify the subset of Xu-538 CpGs with consistent Δβ direction in GSE269244 tumor vs normal, evaluate on held-out subset.
Gleason grade stratification as separate validation (card v0.2 possible scope).

universal_reference._purpose: Self-contained reference block embedded in every EDEAR disease card. Full-inline Option B: do not rely on README_MASTER or any external file for pipeline invariants. A new analyst loading only this card + GAPE_WEB_v13.py must be able to reproduce the full Stage 1 + Stage 2 + Stage 3 pipeline without reading anything else.

universal_stage_1_pipeline.invariant_rule: Every patient's first test is identical regardless of suspected disease: Stage 1 is always immune-class on buffy-coat DNA using the Xu-538 panel with H_min(immune) = 0.838889. This applies to every EDEAR card. What varies per card: expected direction, Stage 2 tissue target, tier thresholds, mandatory covariates, clinical action paths.
universal_stage_1_pipeline.specimen: buffy coat DNA (peripheral blood leukocytes, ~70% immune cells)
universal_stage_1_pipeline.panel_source_paper: Xu Z, Sandler DP, Taylor JA. JNCI 2020;112(1):87-94
universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_method_primary: pooled entropy A-score = mean(H(β)/H_min) across panel
universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_method_secondary_for_bidirection: directional A_dir = mean(direction_i × z_i) when disease drives bidirectional per-CpG drift. Applicable to AD via 7-CpG Rule A panel. Other cards use pooled entropy as primary.

universal_h_min_table._note: Class H_min constants from GAPE_WEB_v13.py lines 87-96. Frozen at G-003b MCMC posterior means, R-hat < 1.001. Used at Stage 2 to compute per-tissue A-scores from deconvolved β values.

universal_stage_2_moss_deconvolution.method: Moss 2018 NNLS deconvolution of the Stage 1 IDAT into 18 per-tissue β values
universal_stage_2_moss_deconvolution.production_module_status: G-DECONV-001 OPEN-DEFERRED. VAL-041 proved the workflow at published-β level (10/10 top-1 correct localization across 10 cancer types). Production per-IDAT deployment requires: (1) 30 MB Moss 2018 reference matrix locked into the repo; (2) Salas 2018 QC harness implemented; (3) assay version tag (L1 Illumina EPIC + Moss markers, L2 custom capture panel, L3 full 5-substrate MESA+DELFI).

universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.method: Teschendorff 2017 EpiDISH RPC mode, Salas 2018 reference
universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.when_applied: Runs when Stage 1 flags AND Stage 2 returns no solid-organ localization. Distinguishes chronic inflammation (neutrophil shift), hematologic immune drift (lymphocyte composition shift), autoimmune patterns, AD-type patterns (brain tissue not in buffy coat).
universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.qc_gate_rule: IDATs outside Salas bounds get QC flag; Stage 2 output not released

universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_cl._purpose: Age-decade mean and SD of pooled-entropy immune-class A-score in healthy reference cohorts. Used to compute age-matched percentile for Stage 1 tier calls. Applies to every card's NORMAL / MARGINAL / DETECTABLE tier logic.
_sources: Hannum 2013 Mol Cell (GSE40279 blood methylation aging)
Roadmap Epigenomics Consortium 2015 Nature (127 reference epigenomes)
universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_cl._critical_caveat_cross_cohort: This baseline is derived from the source cohorts using standard preprocessing (primarily minfi/sesame normalization). Cohorts with different preprocessing pipelines (e.g. Ferrari 2014 GSE53740 with ComBat + quantile normalization) can show cohort-level batch offsets of +2 SD or more relative to this baseline. Example: VAL-057 found GSE53740 HC sit at A_age_z = +2.306 vs this baseline. Any card deployment on a non-AIBL/non-AddNeuroMed cohort requires either (a) re-anchoring to within-cohort HC, or (b) a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale. Do not assume universal applicability of these constants across preprocessing pipelines.

universal_tier_thresholds._source: 80-cell healthy baseline reference; same across breast-epic, crc-epic, ad-immune, lung-epic
universal_tier_thresholds._note: Per-card tier thresholds MAY deviate from these universals if disease-specific literature justifies. When they deviate, the card MUST cite the deviation explicitly. Silent deviation is forbidden.

NORMAL.action: No action; serial-sample per screening cadence

URGENT.action: Run Stage 2; expedited workup per disease card

FLOOR_BREACH.action: Run Stage 2; urgent clinical workup regardless of localization

universal_sex_stratification_rule.rule: Every card's deployment MUST stratify reports by sex when sex-differential signal has been documented in validation. At v2.1 this applies to ad-immune (VAL-051: female d=+0.71 vs male d=+0.51 AIBL; VAL-057 male recovery, female non-replication in GSE53740). For other cards, sex stratification is recommended in deployment even where no sex-differential has been documented, since absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
universal_sex_stratification_rule.minimum_reporting: Report must include patient sex. Card scoring MAY differ by sex if documented in validation.

universal_language_discipline.rationale: Every report must present EDEAR output as a flag that changes downstream workup, never as a diagnosis. Final diagnosis requires clinical assessment plus standard-of-care workup (imaging, tissue biopsy, amyloid PET/CSF for AD, etc.) per the relevant clinical guidelines.

universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.description: VAL-057 established that cohort-level preprocessing artifacts can shift pooled-entropy A-score by +2 SD or more relative to the 80-cell Cookbook baseline. This is a systematic offset, not a biological finding. Applies to any new cohort before its baseline can be used for cross-cohort comparison.
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.example: GSE53740 (Ferrari 2014, 450K + ComBat + quantile normalization): HC mean A_age_z = +2.306 vs 80-cell immune baseline.
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.deployment_rule: (1) On AIBL or AddNeuroMed-equivalent preprocessing: 80-cell baseline usable directly. (2) On any other cohort: re-anchor to within-cohort HC for tier thresholds OR run a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale before applying Cookbook tier thresholds.

universal_no_fabrication_rule.rule: Every numeric value, CpG ID, cohort size, validation result, or citation in this card traces to a primary source or a SHA-locked validation run. Nothing is invented or estimated. If a value is a projection or estimate, it is explicitly labeled as such in its field.

lessons_learned.title: Xu-538 transfers to prostate TISSUE case-control despite being a breast-derived BLOOD panel
lessons_learned.observation: The Xu-538 panel was derived from Sister Study breast cancer peripheral blood methylation. On GSE269244 prostate tumor tissue (n=238, matched pairs n=118), pooled-entropy A-score on Xu-538 separated tumor from adjacent-normal at paired d = +0.497 (p = 0.0001). The panel transferred across both substrate (blood → tissue) and disease (breast → prostate).
lessons_learned.implication: The Xu-538 CpG set captures architectural drift signals that generalize beyond its original derivation context. Useful for building stage_2_only_validated cards on tissue cohorts when per-patient blood cohorts are dbGaP-gated.

lessons_learned.title: Paired analysis substantially outperforms unpaired when tumor-normal pairs are available
lessons_learned.observation: On GSE269244, unpaired d = +0.400 [CI +0.146, +0.659]. Paired d = +0.497 (using 118 patient-matched tumor-normal pairs), with p = 0.0001 vs p = 0.0027 unpaired. The paired analysis power comes from removing inter-patient variance that inflates SD in unpaired comparison.
lessons_learned.implication: For future tissue cohorts with matched tumor-normal specimen pairs, the paired analysis should be the primary reported effect size. Cookbook validation_evidence_summary should always report both.

lessons_learned.title: Genome-wide hypermethylation trend does not dictate panel-specific trend
lessons_learned.observation: GSE269244 original analysis (Berglund 2024 PMID 39162297) reports overall hypermethylation in prostate tumors at genome-wide level. On Xu-538 specifically (n=481 covered CpGs), only 45.1% (217/481) were hypermethylated in tumor — the Xu-538 panel trends slightly hypomethylated on prostate despite the genome-wide hypermethylation trend.
lessons_learned.implication: Published genome-wide direction trends do not automatically apply to a given CpG subset. Panel-specific direction must be verified empirically, not assumed from parent-study headline findings. For cards where "direction preservation" is a validation criterion, the reference direction must be the panel-specific direction in the original training cohort, not the disease's published genome-wide trend.

lessons_learned.title: Public GEO has no adequate prostate BLOOD pre-diagnostic methylation cohort as of April 2026
lessons_learned.observation: Multi-geography GEO hunt (US, Italy, Japan, Korea, China, Sweden, Denmark, African-American cohorts, PRACTICAL consortium, Widschwendter/Kresovich/Bojesen PI searches, PIN progression queries) surfaced 17 GSE candidates for prostate methylation. ALL are tissue cohorts (tumor vs adjacent-normal or tumor vs benign hyperplasia) except GSE108462 / GSE157273 which are metastatic-CRPC cfDNA on abiraterone treatment — not pre-diagnostic. Health ABC, Rotterdam Study, Sister Study prostate arm all dbGaP-gated.
lessons_learned.implication: Prostate-epic card cannot reach cohort_screening_validated tier on public data alone. Card remains at stage_2_only_validated until a dbGaP-approved blood cohort becomes available. This is not a failure — it is an honest representation of the current public evidence landscape.
lessons_learned.source_val: VAL-058 (via GEO hunt documented in session transcript)

lessons_learned.title: Stage_2_only_validated tier has distinct clinical value from cohort_screening_validated
lessons_learned.observation: The prostate-epic card fills a specific clinical gap: when an EDEAR patient's Stage 1 immune panel flags and their Stage 2 Moss NNLS localizes to prostate_epithelial, the card provides clinical action guidance (PSA + DRE + MRI + urology referral). It does NOT claim to be a pre-diagnostic screening test for prostate cancer via blood methylation. These are different clinical use cases with different evidence requirements.
lessons_learned.implication: Tier names matter. stage_2_only_validated communicates: "Stage 2 localization mechanism validated on this tissue; Stage 1 blood screening NOT validated." cohort_screening_validated communicates: "Stage 1 blood screening validated on a case-control cohort." Do not conflate the two tiers in EDEAR report output or commercial marketing copy.
